name: Grok
verdict: New Grok access is the X Subscription, not a standalone SuperGrok plan; Premium at $30 is the useful tier.
pros: Image, video, and voice in the same chat
Premium and up include Grok Bot
cons: You also buy Cursor and X, not Grok alone
Third-party models in Cursor are billed extra
Plus does not include Grok Bot
pricingNote: Annual rates are from docs.x.ai/x-subscription/pricing. Usage is a shared weekly pool: Premium is 4x Plus, Super 15x, Ultra 50x. Existing SuperGrok plans continue unless you switch. Teams seats match the individual Premium, Super, and Ultra prices.
